name: Constanța Casino
elevationDatum: Rigid local foundation y=0; real metres +X east, +Y up, +Z south. Two mapped controls fix rotation, baked into the geometry once. No terrain or Mercator stretch.
note: The restored Art Nouveau casino retains its enormous shell-shaped fan window, twin sculptural corner crests, scalloped salon gables, dark mansard and open eight-bay veranda beneath a low balustrade. No surveyed or reliable primary published total height was found: all vertical dimensions are explicit photo estimates against the mapped 55 m plan. OSM building:levels=1 is not a height measurement and misses the basement, upper hall and partial attic documented by the National Investment Company. The 2025 restored pale exterior is used; the 2016 reference supplies fan and veranda detail only, while the 1944 image is rejected as historical. Sculptural reliefs and scrolls are simplified original geometric motifs. The detailed current seaward facade differs following the restoration; its three large arched bays are an exterior approximation pending independent placement/likeness review. Cityscape: not tested; Full 3D world: not tested.
